title: n8n Review (2026)
intro: n8n is evaluated here as AI software — n8n is a workflow-automation platform with a free Community Edition for self-host and a Cloud ladder priced in EUR. Cloud Starter is €20/mo billed annually (2,500 executions plus AI credits). Pro €50. Business €667. Enterprise quote. Same ai-automation cluster as Zapier — more self-host / execution-volume shaped, not an LLM-assistant peer of ChatGPT. MindStudio is landscape (ai-agents). This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s AI methodology (ease of use, AI job fit, output quality, workflow depth, integrations, governance/privacy, scalability, value, model capability), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose n8n when self-host or EUR Cloud workflow automation is the job — not Zapier by default, and not ChatGPT or MindStudio as the primary product.
verdict: Choose n8n when self-host or EUR Cloud workflow automation is the job — not Zapier by default, and not ChatGPT or MindStudio as the primary product. Compare Zapier for the widest SaaS connector overlay; MindStudio only on landscape pages if the job is building AI agents. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, usage caps and credit rates on the vendor site before purchase.
